rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of FRIGG, greatest Norse goddess, demanding protective oaths from all things animate and inanimate for her son.
ANATOMY: One mature adult female deity rendered as a natural humanlike woman, one head, two eyes, two arms and natural five-fingered hands. She wears an entirely opaque stately high-neck dark walnut ceremonial gown with broad heavy plain gold-brown woven mantle; only hands and face bare. Rich matte fabric with dignified construction, not ragged peasant clothing. No crown or invented divine attributes. [frigg-c01, frigg-c02]
MOMENT: Pronounce the binding promise with stern sovereign authority while visibly receiving an oath assembly; she leans toward the viewer from a very close low angle, face raised slightly and mouth open mid-decree, her right open hand held vertical at shoulder height in a decisive oath-command, left hand lowered toward a rough stone. In the left middle distance, two fully clothed adult human oath witnesses face HER and raise one natural hand each to solemnly promise; a natural living stag stands beside the witnesses and faces her, its antlers remaining background rather than an attribute of her. A living tree trunk and rough inert stone stand opposite as examples of animate and inanimate things. The subjects attend the goddess, never the viewer. This is a sacred oath-taking assembly, not a woman hiking or reaching for help. [frigg-c10]
POWER: Extracting promises from all things that they will not harm her son; show the deed physically through the witnesses' oath gestures and the goddess's decree. No documented visible magical mechanism, so no magic effects. [frigg-c10]
SCALE & CAMERA: Extreme low camera close to the goddess's waist; her face, shoulders and robe occupy 75 percent of the square, imposing strong triangular silhouette; oath witnesses clearly smaller only because they stand several steps behind, NOT because she is a giant. Face intensely confronts viewer. Foreground stone plain and non-glowing. Head and oath-hand legible at 200 pixels.
LIGHT & WEATHER: One low warm sunset source behind the oath witnesses, thin hard rim on solemn fabric and side-lit austere face; rest of scene deep warm shadow, natural thin dust only. Strong dark walnut and antique gold palette; no divine halo.
SURFACE: Dense woven ceremonial cloth, natural lined skin, living bark, stag hair, rough dark stone.
SETTING: Unspecified outdoor assembly along her journey through the Nine Realms; no invented Fensalir architecture or special terrain. [frigg-c10]
MOOD: Overwhelming sacred maternal authority; imposing royal goddess in decisive action, the witnesses compelled to solemn attention, awe rather than fear of an evil monster.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: No text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no crown, weapon, spindle, magical birds, jewellery, runes or borrowed iconography; no film/game/anime/comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no glowing eyes, halos, generic aura, neon lines, energy ribbons, lightning, levitation or invented power. Do not show a concerned ordinary woman, casual pedestrian, calm portrait or landscape without a dominant goddess.

visual_requirements.description: Female goddess in fully opaque plain ceremonial garments, no invented attributes.
Extracting protective promises from animate and inanimate things, depicted as oath witnesses facing her; no magic.
Unspecified assembly in the Nine Realms where she collects the oaths.

artistic_choices: Adult human witnesses, a living stag/tree and inert stone exemplify c10 animate/inanimate categories; their ceremonial attention is editorial, no specific source scene claimed.
Richly woven opaque ceremonial clothes, natural humanlike face/anatomy and an oath-decree gesture are editorial rendering of c01/c02 goddess identity.
No glow or visible prophecy/magic; no unsupported giant size.
Small background participants are farther from camera, not scale markers proving giant stature.
